commit.message:
SCP-5085 - Simple contracts list view working (#14)

* Reformatted the web server code

Changed spacing and indenting, sometimes using more whitespaces.
Reordered the REST endpoints to be more logically like how they would be
called during use of the app.

* Refactored repetitive code to make the Marlowe Runtime URL prefix

* Moved FromJSON instances closer to the type defs

I'm about to add some more types and think instances are often best kept
near the data declarations if possible as files get longer and more full
of things.

* SCP-5085 - Simple contract list view working

This is a first attempt at this, displaying ALL Marlowe contracts that
come back from the REST call with no paging or automatic refreshing.

The contract links drill down into contract details and a link is
available from the contract tab pages to navigate back to this list.

Some work was done to refactor some types used for parsing the JSON.
More work of this type is coming soon.

Also found an extra import hiding in Explorer.Web.ContractView

* Updated hie.yaml

* Clarified only 100 contracts visible at this time

* Factored out the Link concept into a reusable type

This value is used several places but we always see a single useful
value in it. This code provides a Link type we can use everywhere
provided we're explicit about how it's parsed from the JSON in each

Changed spacing and indenting, sometimes using more whitespaces.
Reordered the REST endpoints to be more logically like how they would be
called during use of the app.

near the data declarations if possible as files get longer and more full
of things.

This is a first attempt at this, displaying ALL Marlowe contracts that
come back from the REST call with no paging or automatic refreshing.

The contract links drill down into contract details and a link is
available from the contract tab pages to navigate back to this list.

More work of this type is coming soon.

Also found an extra import hiding in Explorer.Web.ContractView

* Updated hie.yaml

This value is used several places but we always see a single useful
value in it. This code provides a Link type we can use everywhere
provided we're explicit about how it's parsed from the JSON in each
case (the JSON paths vary i.e. links.contract vs links.transactions)
